settings_registry_capture_capture_key_re: Help line under the "Region" row in Settings > Capture, also shown in search results.
settings_registry_capture_capture_on_rel: Help line under the "Capture when the mouse is released" row in Settings > Capture, also shown in search results.
settings_registry_capture_description: One line under the Capture page title in Settings, and the tooltip of its sidebar entry.
settings_registry_capture_group_history: Title of the "History" card on the Capture page of Settings, shown above its rows and in the path of search results.
settings_registry_capture_label: Sidebar entry and page title of the Capture section in Settings.
